'''Lake Marudi''' was a [[lake]] on the [[forest]] [[moon]] [[Endor]]. The body of [[water]] consisted of two large open portions connected by a strait on the northern edge of the lake. It was located 3.1 [[kilometer]]s (2 miles) to the south-east of [[Bright Tree Village]], home to a [[Bright Tree tribe|tribe]] of Endor's [[Ewok]] [[Homeworld|natives]], and to the west of a [[Death Star's shield generator|shield generator bunker]] constructed by the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CL 2016" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the [[Battle of Endor]] to [[4 ABY]].</ref> an army of Ewoks from the village and a group of their [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] allies crossed over Lake Marudi's strait using an Ewok-made rope bridge while trekking toward the bunker in order to rendezvous there with more [[Endor strike team|Alliance forces]] and [[Battle of Endor|attack]] the Imperials.<ref name="CL 2016" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Lake Marudi was first mentioned in the [[2016]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]. The map depicting Lake Marudi in the book was a reprint<ref name="CL 2016" /> of a map created for the [[2004]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'' by [[Richard Chasemore]] and [[Hans Jenssen]]. The book was written by [[James Luceno]] and marked the lake's first mention in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>
